item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":15,"statement":"When `LM` infers a provider automatically, it selects `OpenAIProvider()` only for model strings that start with `openai/` or `ft:`; otherwise it falls back to the base `Provider()`.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":15,"statement":"OpenAI fine-tuning accepts only `TrainDataFormat.CHAT` and `TrainDataFormat.COMPLETION`, and `OpenAIProvider.finetune` validates the requested format before continuing.","span_ids":["s3","s4"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"`OpenAIProvider.finetune` saves the training data with `save_data`, uploads it, stores the returned upload id on `job.provider_file_id`, starts remote fine-tuning with that file and stores the returned job id on `job.provider_job_id`, waits for completion, and then returns the provider-reported fine-tuned model name.","span_ids":["s5","s6"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"`LM._run_finetune_job` takes the model string returned by `provider.finetune`, creates a copied `LM` with `self.copy(model=model)`, and sets that `LM` object as the training job result.","span_ids":["s7"]},{"claim_id":"c5","claim_type":"core","weight":15,"statement":"`TrainingJobOpenAI.cancel()` cancels an existing nonterminal provider job, clears `provider_job_id`, deletes the uploaded provider file if it still exists, clears `provider_file_id`, and then calls the base `cancel()` logic.","span_ids":["s8"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/clients/openai.py","start_line":48,"end_line":55},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":307,"end_line":310},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/clients/openai.py","start_line":72,"end_line":74},{"span_id":"s4","path":"dspy/clients/openai.py","start_line":156,"end_line":164},{"span_id":"s5","path":"dspy/clients/openai.py","start_line":63,"end_line":100},{"span_id":"s6","path":"dspy/clients/openai.py","start_line":218,"end_line":227},{"span_id":"s7","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":290,"end_line":305},{"span_id":"s8","path":"dspy/clients/openai.py","start_line":17,"end_line":35}]}
